name: WTS Capital Berhad
overview: 公司由 Systech Bhd. 更名为 WTS Capital Berhad，本年度营收由 2025 财年的 RM41.844 million 增至 2026 财年的 RM335.259 million，最新一季（2026-06-30）营收为 RM152.036 million，同比增长 906.3%。公告中未披露各业务板块的具体运营变化。
overview_en: The company changed its name from Systech Bhd. to WTS Capital Berhad and proposed a reduction of issued share capital of up to RM40.00 million. Revenue increased from RM41.844 million in FY2025 to RM335.259 million in FY2026, with the latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue at RM152.036 million, up 906.3% year-on-year. The announcements do not disclose specific operational changes by business segment.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 同时更换了提案的主要顾问。
segments.note_en: The company proposed a reduction of issued share capital and a change of name to WTS Capital Berhad, and changed the principal adviser for the proposals.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 终止 Apex Securities Berhad 作为提案顾问的服务，并委任 M & A Securities Sdn Bhd 为新的主要顾问。
actions.text_en: Terminated Apex Securities Berhad's services as adviser for the proposals and appointed M & A Securities Sdn Bhd as the new principal adviser.

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text: 并削减最多 RM40.00 million 的已发行股本。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed to change the company name from Systech Bhd. to WTS Capital Berhad and to reduce issued share capital by up to RM40.00 million.
